rationale: First suborbital design (2026-10-28), built only from Start, Basic Rocketry and Engineering 101 parts. An RT-10 Hammer with four basic fins lifts it, a TD-12 drops the Hammer, an RT-5 Flea pushes the pod past 70 km, and a second TD-12 drops the Flea so the Mk1 pod comes down alone under its Mk16 chute. About 1,700 m/s in vacuum, roughly 1,250 m/s after drag and gravity: enough for space straight up.
